summary: Alterity Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K announcing the USPTO grant of a new composition-of-matter patent for ATH434, its lead oral agent for neurodegenerative diseases. The patent covers a crystalline mesylate salt form and treatment methods, extending protection to at least 2045. No financial terms, transactions, or strategic processes are involved; this is a routine intellectual property milestone. The company plans to initiate Phase 3 trials in multiple system atrophy by year-end 2026 and may pursue Parkinson's disease. This filing is not a special situation; it is a routine current report on corporate development.
